## Verification

<!-- Tick what you actually ran, and paste the result where it is interesting. -->

- [ ] `zig build test-parallel`
- [ ] `zig build test262 -Doptimize=ReleaseFast` (or a `--diag` before/after diff)
- [ ] `zig build threads-test` / `python3 tools/nogil-corpus-gate.py`
- [ ] `zig build test -Dtsan=true`
- [ ] `zig build threadfuzz -Dfuzz-iters=400`
- [ ] The matching `*-audit` step (ABI surfaces)
- [ ] `zig build docs-link-check` and `bun run docs:build` (docs)
- [ ] Not applicable — explain below

## Checklist

- [ ] Semantics changed in `interpreter.zig` are mirrored in `vm.zig` where the
      VM implements the same operation (the corpus will not catch this for you)
- [ ] New shared mutable state has an explicit synchronization ruling; anything
      process-global is listed in `docs/threads/bindings.md`
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated by their `tools/gen_*` script, not
      hand-edited
- [ ] No hand edits inside a marker-delimited generated region
      (`release-compatibility:*`, `benchmark-comparison`, `gc-generation`)
- [ ] Any number added to docs traces to `docs/.data/`, a saved transcript, or
      output from this change
